name: 79903 · El Paso, TX
findings: ZIP 79903 (El Paso) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79903 (El Paso) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79903 (El Paso) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
